name: Computer Use
description: Native Anthropic Computer Use tool (computer_20251124) — screen capture, mouse/keyboard control via the Operator action protocol. Tauri Rust backend ships in a follow-up.
author: cognia-next

browser.hint: Requires Tauri Rust commands for screen capture and input synthesis — desktop only.

tauri.hint: The plugin registers the native tool definitions and renderer-side dispatch wiring. Drives the Rust uiautomation/xcap backend in src-tauri/src/automation/ via the plugin_computer_use_* Tauri commands.
